_note: Found while looking for Bike Walk RVA, which this org runs - and the calendar carries NO cycling. It is their free community fitness programme: 'Aqua Fitness w/ Pam', 'Cee's Cardio', 'Morning Motivation w/ Pam'. Kept under its own name because Richmond had no fitness source at all, and declined as a BIKE source in tribe_sources.json._not_included so the next cycling sweep does not mistake it for one. MEASURED: 10 VEVENTs, 4 ingested - 6 carry no LOCATION or GEO and the adapter drops them rather than guess. The adapter says so on every run ('more than half this feed has no location'), which is the signal to ask them for a richer export.
